title: Portal Chats on the phone: the same swipe tools inside an open conversation
text: On your phone, swipe the top of an open conversation in Portal Chats. Swipe right to mark it read or unread and to pin it; swipe left to make a note or copy its link. Pin and Note were not available inside an open chat before. The computer is unchanged.
points: Swipe the top bar right: Read / Unread and Pin / Unpin
Swipe it left: Note and Copy link
Tap the open bar to close it; scrolling the messages works as before
stepsTitle: Using the swipe tools inside a chat

steps.name: Open a conversation
steps.detail: Tap it in the list as usual.

steps.name: Swipe the name bar at the top
steps.detail: Right for Read / Unread and Pin; left for Note and Copy link.

steps.name: Press a button
steps.detail: It does the action and the bar closes.
